goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/application_controller.rb:159 — Fallback locale files are loaded only for controller requests, so jobs, mailers, and other server-side translations still miss site/default and English fallbacks under the lazy loader.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is only called in `set_locale` within ApplicationController (line 159), which is a controller callback. The diff shows the FallbackLocaleList class with `ensure_loaded!` method that loads fallback locale files. Background jobs, mailers, and other non-controller code paths would not trigger this method, meaning fallback translations wouldn't be properly loaded in those contexts. This is a legitimate architectural gap in the implementation.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:12 — FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash while ignoring stored entries in #[], so ordinary Hash mutation silently has no effect and makes the fallback API misleading.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that FallbackLocaleList extends Hash but overrides #[] to always return a computed array based on locale, ignoring any stored values. This means if someone calls `I18n.fallbacks[:en] = [:fr]` expecting to set a custom fallback, it would be silently ignored since #[] always computes the fallback dynamically. While this is intentional design (the TODO comment suggests future per-language customization), the API is misleading because it inherits Hash's mutation methods that have no effect. This is a valid architectural concern about the new code, though not a bug since the current usage doesn't rely on mutation.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:13 — The new locale fallback order and deduplication behavior has no automated coverage for user, site-default, and English fallback cases.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces new nontrivial logic in FallbackLocaleList class (lines 12-23 in config/initializers/i18n.rb) that implements custom locale fallback behavior - specifically the [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact chain. This is new functionality that affects internationalization behavior across the application. The finding correctly identifies that this new logic lacks automated test coverage. While the diff doesn't show test files, the absence of tests for this new fallback mechanism is a legitimate concern for code that handles locale resolution.
